description: 72hr Parking Ordinance Violations is a dataset listed in City of Seattle open data portal (cos-data.seattle.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Seattle. This data set contains selected information for Abandoned Vehicle/72hr Parking Ordinance service requests. Coverage: Seattle. The portal files it under the category City Administration. Its tags are neighborhood, service request, parking, customer, vehicle infractions. The table has 18 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Seattle. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-cos-data-seattle-gov-portal.
